scope:
Autonomous normal-main assembly activation on two predeclared native maps.

This is a local integration test, not a strength benchmark. Every allied owner
uses the byte-identical production main and headers. Only the opponent is inert.
No mission, allied action, visibility, wallet, claim or World is scripted.

map_manifest.scope: Two predeclared local autonomous integration activation maps. No candidate results used in selection. Not holdout/strength samples. Official map/camp definitions and native integrity verification only.
map_manifest.candidate_policy: All production main/header bytes copied unchanged. No scripted allied movement, mission, claim, World, stats or wallet edits. Quiet opponent only drafts/yields.
map_manifest.required_evidence: Accepted production crew-paid camp damage, at least two autonomous allied damage contributors to the same native group, actual group clear then gem receipt then a bank by a recipient with no intervening gem loss.

maps.purpose: Autonomous multi-monster crew, real capture and small split-bag conversion. Non-opaque hole detour makes the visible singleton alternative longer to walk. Production draft may create four physical bodies from three picks.

map_manifest.selection_note: Original predeclared three-pick case only; paired corrected five-pick spawn4 case is run from its retained independent manifest. No map byte changed or target changed.
